dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Live federation state, refreshed every 5 seconds.
dashboard.queue_empty_hint: Submitted jobs appear here until they finish.
dashboard.no_workers_hint: Add a worker to hand out a registration bundle and bring GPUs into the federation.
dashboard.metric_disk_hint: Free space reported in the worker's last heartbeat.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.subtitle: Submit ComfyUI workflows and follow them through the federation.
jobs.editor_hint: Open the embedded ComfyUI editor, wire up your graph, and press Queue — the job goes straight into the federation.
jobs.editor_workers_note: Nodes only appear once at least one worker is online; the editor shows the union of what the online workers have installed.
jobs.paste_section_hint: For a workflow you already exported with “Save (API format)”.
jobs.submit_hint: Paste ComfyUI API-format JSON, or upload a .json file. Requirements are detected automatically.
jobs.parse_not_api_format: This does not look like a ComfyUI API-format workflow (export with "Save (API format)").
jobs.assets_hint: The workflow loads these images. Attach each one so the assigned worker receives it with the job.
jobs.blocked_by_assets: Attach every input file before submitting.
jobs.advanced_hint: Optional — leave empty for automatic assessment.
jobs.backend_hint: Pin the job to one backend.
jobs.empty_hint: Submit a workflow above and it will show up here.
jobs.load_error: Could not load jobs. Retrying automatically.
jobs.assessment_error: Could not load the assessment for this job.
jobs.assessment_no_workers_hint: Register at least one worker before this job can be dispatched.
jobs.cancel_confirm_body: Job {{id}} will stop immediately. No charge is recorded for a cancelled job.

job_detail.title: Job {{id}}

workers.title: Workers
workers.subtitle: Registered GPU workers in this federation.

workers.bundle_warning: This registration token is shown once and can only be used once.
workers.install_title: One-line install (copy and run on that machine)

workers.empty_hint: Issue a registration bundle and run the agent on a GPU machine to join it to the federation.
workers.load_error: Could not load workers. Retrying automatically.
workers.confirm_hint: Jobs already running on it are unaffected. This cannot be undone from the console.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Manage login accounts for this federation console.
users.add_body: Set an account name and role; leave the password blank to have the server generate a random one.
users.password_hint: If left blank, the server generates a random password.
users.empty_hint: Create the first account so others can sign in to the console.
users.load_error: Could not load the user list. Retrying automatically.
users.reset_confirm_body: A new random password will be generated for "{{name}}". The old password stops working immediately and any signed-in sessions are logged out.
users.enable_confirm_body: "{{name}}" will be able to sign in to the console again.
users.disable_confirm_body: "{{name}}" will no longer be able to sign in, and any signed-in sessions are logged out.
users.password_warning: This password is shown only this once -- save it now.
users.password_body: "{{name}}"'s password is shown below; it cannot be retrieved once you close this window.

reports.page_subtitle: Worker contributions, per-user usage, and payout estimates.

reports.subtitle: GPU time contributed by each worker, from dual-signed job receipts.
reports.empty_hint: Receipts are written when a worker finishes a job. Try a wider date range.
reports.load_error: Could not load the contribution report.
reports.usage_empty_hint: Rows appear once a job finishes and its receipt is written. Try a wider date range.
reports.usage_load_error: Could not load the user usage report.
reports.payout_empty: No billable GPU time in this range to split
reports.my_usage_subtitle: Your own GPU usage, from dual-signed job receipts.
